title: Neck 01 — Memory-foam pillow
descriptionHtml:
Neck 01 is our contoured memory-foam pillow. Two heights, one on each side, so you choose the one that fits the way you lie. The foam holds its shape through the night instead of flattening under your head.

The cover is included. It has a cool-touch surface and goes in the washing machine.

  • 62 × 42 × 13/11 cm (24.4 × 16.5 × 5.1/4.3 in)
  • Memory foam, cooling cover included
  • 1.4 kg (3.1 lb)
  • Ships in 6–10 days. Free shipping.

title: Body 01 — S-shaped body pillow
descriptionHtml:
Body 01 is a 120 cm body pillow shaped like an S. It sits between the knees, under the arm and along the back at the same time, so the whole body is held in one position.

The removable cover is breathable, cool to the touch and machine washable. It is included.

  • 120 cm long, about 30 cm wide (47.2 × 11.8 in)
  • Removable, washable, breathable cool-touch cover included
  • 1.8 kg (4.0 lb)
  • Ships in 6–10 days. Free shipping.
